title: Explore Once, Evaluate Many: Multiple Policy Evaluation for Stochastic Linear Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2610.22252v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study how to evaluate $K$ target policies simultaneously in stochastic contextual bandits with linear reward structure. Given a known $d$-dimensional feature map and reward-free access to policy queries, we propose PRISMA (Policy evaluation through Regularized Information Sharing and Mixture Allocation), an algorithm that estimates every target policy's value to accuracy $\varepsilon$ with probability at least $1-\delta$. The algorithm uses $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\!\left( \frac{(L^2S^2+\beta^2)(1\vee\rho^\star)}{\varepsilon^2} \cdot \log(K) \right)$ context draws and reward observations, where $\rho^\star\le d$ is an instance-dependent measure of the difficulty of designing a shared sampling distribution. translated_title: 一次探索，多次评估：随机线性老虎机中的多策略评估
translated_abstract: 我们研究如何在具有线性奖励结构的随机上下文老虎机中同时评估 $K$ 个目标策略。在给定已知的 $d$ 维特征映射并可以无奖励方式访问策略查询的条件下，我们提出了 PRISMA（通过正则化信息共享与混合分配进行策略评估）算法，该算法能够以至少 $1-\delta$ 的概率将每个目标策略的价值估计到精度 $\varepsilon$。该算法使用 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}\!\left( \frac{(L^2S^2+\beta^2)(1\vee\rho^\star)}{\varepsilon^2} \cdot \log(K) \right)$ 次上下文抽取和奖励观测，其中 $\rho^\star\le d$ 是一个与实例相关的量，用于衡量设计共享采样分布的难度。其中，$L$、$S$ 和 $\beta$ 分别约束特征范数、奖励参数范数和奖励噪声，被省略的因子是关于 $K$、$d$ 和 $1/\delta$ 的对数项。我们的方法结合了无奖励规划、正则化……（摘要在此截断）
tldr: 提出了 PRISMA 算法，通过一次无奖励探索收集数据并结合正则化信息共享与混合分配，能够在随机线性上下文老虎机中以样本复杂度仅随策略数 $K$ 对数增长的代价同时高精度评估 $K$ 个目标策略的价值。
en_tdlr: PRISMA simultaneously evaluates K target policies in stochastic linear contextual bandits with sample complexity logarithmic in K, by combining reward-free exploration with regularized information sharing and mixture allocation of a shared sampling distribution.
